chunks: (The Pharaoh) said: "If you took another god apart from me I will have you incarcerated."
ai.seo_question: What did Pharaoh threaten to do if Moses worshipped a god other than him?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara, Pharaoh issues a stark ultimatum to Moses, equating monotheism with treason against his own divinity. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of 'Taghut' as the usurpation of divine authority by worldly rulers, where political obedience is demanded in place of spiritual truth. The threat of imprisonment underscores the historical pattern of tyrants suppressing prophetic messengers to maintain their claim to absolute sovereignty.
